objective: Creator sees exact-feature construction findings, corrects an outward-facing room wall, reviews unusually sized desk without losing intentional editability, and saves/reloads corrected geometry.
summary: Final visible-guidance packet meets this bounded rendered objective. Desktop findings identify reference desk and wall front with actionable explanations and feature buttons. Wall rotation visibly changes the displayed room/cutaway and removes that finding. Phone guidance is open and readable; height/y fields remain editable. Save/reload retains corrected construction, renders the room and presents zero findings. No blocker confirmed in this narrow journey.

inspection.method: All supplied stills at native image size; full start-to-end decoded recording chronology at 2 frames/second before any frozen source. Contact sheets preserve actual frames, not reconstruction. Failed 102 frames, intermediate 61, final 64.
inspection.limitation: Sampled chronology rather than continuous playback of every encoded frame; sub-half-second states and subjective smoothness unqualified.
inspection.excluded: Builder rationale and current working source.

sourceCorroboration.scope: Broad desk/table height review range 0.1-3m; realized part height creates WARNING UNUSUAL_FURNISHING_SCALE, independent of provenance. Outward usable wall face creates ERROR OUTWARD_WALL_SURFACE. Return status depends on ERROR only, physicalCalibration false, and bounds do not certify meshes or physical accessibility.

Exact feature/part identities for outward wall; confident miniature realized geometry still warns without blocking status; missing parts, extent/openings, support, overlap, containment and invalid/tilted rotations have separate tests. These are source corroboration, not additional rendered journeys.

Fixture seeds outward wall and desk height/y at 10%; natural Studio Library saved scene entry; buttons select exact features; rotation180, phone warning open and visible, height/y restored; save/reload exact draft equality and no pageerrors.
